paragraphs: Rav Adda Karchinai challenges Rabbi Elazar, Chelek 92a. Before Rav Kahana he spoke in Rava’s name, Yevamot 10a. Yuchasin lists Rav Adda Kartigenya (see Rabbi Abba, Rabbi Acha, Rabbi Chana), before Rav Kahana in Rava’s name, at the beginning of Yevamot [printed כ״ק], and gives him a separate entry. They are one, not two. She'erit Yosef counts him among Rav’s students; perhaps he had an erroneous Yevamot reading, “in Rav’s name.”
